react.description: A `div[popover=manual]` in the top layer, positioned next to `anchorEl` by the core popover controller. Controlled, like MUI: keep `open` in state and set it from `onOpenChange`.

props.description: The element the popover points at.
props.name: anchorEl

props.description: Draws an arrow pointing at the anchor.
props.name: arrow

props.description: Focus stays on the anchor when the popover opens (hover popovers).
props.name: disableAutoFocus

props.description: Focus isn't moved back to the anchor on close.
props.name: disableRestoreFocus

props.description: Where focus goes on open; default: the first focusable element, else the popover.
